block_delay_seconds.description: The amount of time (in seconds) that {{control|use}} must be held before successfully blocking attacks. Defaults to {{cd|0}}.

disable_cooldown_scale.description: The multiplier applied to the number of seconds that the item will be on cooldown for when attacked by a disabling attack (The multiplier for {{nbt|float|disable_blocking_for_seconds}} on the [ [Data component format#weapon|{{cd|minecraft:weapon}}] ] component). If set to {{cd|0}}, this item can never be disabled by attacks. Defaults to {{cd|1}}.

damage_reductions.description: Controls how much damage should be blocked in a given attack.

types.description: {{json_ref|damage type|tag=1}} The damage types to block. Can either be a damage type id, a damage type tag prefixed with {{cd|#}} or a list of damage type ids. Defaults to all damage types.

base.description: The constant amount of damage to be blocked.

factor.description: The fraction of the dealt damage to be blocked.

item_damage.description: Controls how much damage should be applied to the item from a given attack.

threshold.description: The minimum amount of damage dealt by the attack before item damage is applied to the item.

base.description: The constant amount of damage applied to the item, if threshold is passed.

factor.description: The fraction of the dealt damage that should be applied to the item, if threshold is passed.

block_sound.description: {{json_ref|sound event|inline=1}} to play when an attack is successfully blocked. Defaults to none{{verify|Does it default to none?}}.

disable_sound.description: {{json_ref|sound event|inline=1}} to play when the item goes on its disabled cooldown due to an attack. Defaults to none{{verify|Does it default to none?}}.

blocks_attacks.description: When present, this item can be used like a shield to block attacks to the holding player.
